# V2 artifact facts — UI runtime-evidence addendum

## Recorded execution reviewed

The normal locked all-features AndroidTools suite completed successfully: **202 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored, 0 filtered** (85 library +28 generated-artifact +20 import +21 component-tree +29 facts +19 preferences tests). The raw log contains all six matching unfiltered summaries and both original version-ordering tests are included in the 28-test target. The owner touched the crate root with unchanged bytes; Cargo compiler JSON names this worktree and marks the current normal library and all six test artifacts `fresh:false`. This prevents relying on another worktree's shared-cache result.

Recorded repository Clippy (`./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools`, expanded release/all-targets/all-features/deny-warnings invocation) and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` both exit 0. The subsequent normal all-features library build exits 0. The Rust decoder was linked against that same normal Cargo AndroidTools library. I rehashed its library, decoder source, decoder executable and exact production bridge copy; all match the recorded identities:

- AndroidTools normal library: `bf2d8ee866f659ee864387a311a0749c168b3c2e6fb06c06226ca8f0713e00ff`.
- Decoder source: `5551985487b7e87f31963365ccf203f138de5f7bb4ebb2d5f4ca9d9b9a971dca`.
- Decoder executable: `531cc5f5ee7ca35a304513a9f8ab0b8f7246232e8674a10fa5239f4dfd19702f`.
- Production/frozen Gradle bridge: `508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7`.

The recorded production-closure boundary run and Rust assertion driver both exit 0 for **11 cases**. Their output preserves null/wrong collection or map as unavailable, actual empty collections/maps as available-empty, `/tmp/z,/tmp/a,/tmp/z` encounter order and duplicates, Android nullable task values, Java Android-only fields as not-applicable, and absent artifacts separately. These results support the previously reviewed data semantics; they are supplementary helper-boundary evidence.

All **five actual SDK modes** have successful Gradle commands, one project-model record each, successful current-library Rust decoding/assertions, empty Rust stderr and byte-equivalent decoded module data to the raw SDK sidecar:

| Mode | Recorded UI-facing transport outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Java source | SDK JAVA_SOURCE mode exports the task-produced BuildConfig source root and no BuildConfig generated-classpath entry. |
| Bytecode | SDK JAR mode exports `buildConfigGeneratedClasses` separately from source folders. The Rust driver checks the exact official task output, ZIP bytes and that the JAR path is absent from source folders. |
| Custom DSL field with bytecode requested | SDK JAVA_SOURCE mode, official `FACT_STRING` task field and source root remain consistent; no JAR entry is invented. |
| Disabled BuildConfig | SDK available-null mode, no BuildConfig tasks and no BuildConfig classpath entry are retained; other source/resource/assets facts remain available. |
| Disabled/absent artifact fixture | Debug host artifact remains present; release host/device artifact lists are available-empty and fixture slots are absent. The decoder does not turn these states into unavailable or invent artifact rows. This evidence establishes the observed mapping, not a UI toggle workflow. |

Each mode preserves generated resources/assets outside the SDK build folder, exact variant identities and revision binding. The driver rejects an unreported variant with `MissingVariant`. SDK raw version identities are retained (AGP9.4.0, producer23.0, minimum consumer66.1, including their actual descriptions); no inferred facet/language label appears.

## Guard and cleanup evidence

I independently rehashed the **4,612-file fixed whole-source guard**, all **184 immutable originals**, the eight current frozen files and all **13 fixture inputs** in both the original and restored private fixture: all match. The current worktree remains clean. The completion cleanup record confirms whole-source/content and index blob-tree agreement, with a later index stat/cache refresh explicitly distinguished from content changes. The five owned single-use daemon logs match their recorded hashes and contain shutdown evidence; cleanup records their absence and leaves the observed unowned daemon untouched. I did not start or stop any process during this review.

## Scope retained

This is supplementary AGP9.4/Gradle9.6.1/JDK21 transport evidence, not execution under the exact pinned Studio helper. It supplies **zero** original AndroidProjectViewTest runtime credit. AAPT/data-binding/Safe Args/KAPT visibility conversion, generated/light-class tree rendering, folder-group ordering, Kotlin facet equivalence, controller publication/refresh, native UI screenshots, matching-source full app validation and lead full-workspace/CI gates remain separate outstanding work. No screenshot, Android Studio visual fidelity, full application, five original tree tests, Phase 1 completion or IDE completion is claimed.

The existing JVM bridge exception remains limited to reading official Gradle/SDK-owned tooling objects; model validation and IDE policy are Rust. This addendum introduces no additional exception.
